request.text: Miso is asleep beside the seedling tray. Look at me to acknowledge that, give one blink without moving toward the tray, and remind me at 9 tonight to shut the greenhouse vent.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user to acknowledge the sleeping cat beside the seedlings.
Blink once without moving toward the seedling tray.
Create a 9 PM reminder to shut the greenhouse vent.

new_goals.description: Look at the user in acknowledgment.
new_goals.source_text: Look at me to acknowledge that
constraints: Do not move toward the seedling tray.
success_criteria: A look-at-person action is completed without locomotion.

new_goals.description: Blink exactly once while remaining in place.
new_goals.source_text: give one blink without moving toward the tray
constraints: Do not walk toward the tray.
success_criteria: One blink is completed without locomotion.

new_goals.description: Set a reminder to shut the greenhouse vent.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 9 tonight to shut the greenhouse vent
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 9 PM tonight.
success_criteria: The vent-closing reminder is created for the requested time.

semantic_facts: The look, single blink, and greenhouse reminder remain three separately owned Goal outcomes.
The embodied actions must not introduce locomotion toward the sleeping cat or seedlings.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it moved toward, touched, or woke Miso.
The assistant silently substitutes a blink or look for creating the reminder.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Multiple short embodied Goals are fused into an unowned gesture that loses the exact blink constraint.
A locomotion capability is introduced despite an explicit remain-in-place boundary around a pet and seedlings.
